# discord_role_everyone (Resource)

Manages the @everyone role permissions for a Discord server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Number) The bitwise value of the @everyone role's permissions.
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the @everyone role (same as server_id).
